name: @scramjet/transform-hub
description: A development repo for Scramjet Transform Hub, a container supervisor that allows deployment, execution and monitoring of any application based on a simple interface.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:refapps && npm run build:docker
scripts.build:all-packages: npm run build:packages && npm run build:refapps
scripts.pack:pub: npm run clean:root && FLAT_PACKAGES=true MAKE_PUBLIC=true NO_INSTALL=true scripts/build-all.js -w '!bdd' --ts-config tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:memory-guard-bdd-focused: ulimit -v 1835008 2>/dev/null && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" node scripts/run-ava.js scripts/test/bdd-options.spec.js scripts/test/bdd-memory-guard.spec.js scripts/test/run-bdd.spec.js scripts/test/bdd-memory-registry.spec.js --serial
scripts.test:memory-guard-sequence-test: cd packages/sequence-test && ulimit -v 1835008 2>/dev/null && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" SCRAMJET_AVA_MEMORY_GUARD=1 node ../../scripts/run-ava.js test/harness/captures.spec.ts test/harness/index.spec.ts
scripts.test:bdd-appcontext: npm run pack:appcontext-fixtures && SCRAMJET_SPAWN_TS=1 RUNTIME_ADAPTER=process PACKAGES_DIR="data/sequences/appcontext-packages/" node scripts/run-bdd.js -- features/appcontext/APPCONTEXT-001-full-sequence.feature --tags "@ci-appcontext and not @ignore" --exit --format @cucumber/pretty-formatter
scripts.install:clean: npm run clean && npm run clean:modules && npm install
scripts.download:refapps: cd refapps && wget -q 'https://api.github.com/repos/scramjetorg/reference-apps/releases/latest' -O - | jq -r '.assets[].browser_download_url' | xargs -n 4 -P ${MAX_PARALLEL:-$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu 2>/dev/null || echo 1)} wget -q -nc
scripts.test:bdd-ci-hub: NO_HOST=true node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@ci-hub and not @requires-docker and not @docker-specific and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-ci-hub-docker: NO_HOST=true RUNTIME_ADAPTER=docker node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@ci-hub and @requires-docker and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-manager-migration: BDD_INCLUDE_LONG_RUNNING=1 node scripts/run-bdd.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@manager-migration and not @ignore and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-ci-api-node: node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@ci-api and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-ci-api-topic: node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@ci-topic and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-ci-python: npm run pack:python-bdd-fixtures && PACKAGES_DIR="data/sequences/python-bdd-packages/" node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@ci-instance-python and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-ci-node: node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --format=@cucumber/pretty-formatter -t "@ci-instance-node and not @slow and not @stress and not @perf and not @load and not @external-dependency and not @compatibility"
scripts.test:bdd-long: npm run pack:python-bdd-fixtures && BDD_INCLUDE_LONG_RUNNING=1 node scripts/run-bdd-docker.js -- --fail-fast -t "@slow or @stress or @perf or @load or @external-dependency or @compatibility or @manager-migration or @requires-docker or @docker-specific"
scripts.prebump:packages: NEXT_VER=$(npx semver -i ${VERSION_LEVEL:-prerelease} $(jq -r .version < package.json)) && git diff --exit-code --quiet && npm run bump:images && ./scripts/add-to-packages-json.js --pattern={bdd/,packages/**/}package.json -o version "${NEXT_VER}" && bash ./scripts/bump-dependencies-versions.sh "${NEXT_VER}" && git add .
scripts.bump:postversion: npm run pack:pub && npm run publish:dist && git push --follow-tags

author: Scramjet <open-source@scramjet.org>
